notes.title: Multiplayer added
notes.content:
[p]🎉 [b]Exciting News! Multiplayer Just Got Better![/b] 🎉[/p][p]You can now [b]play with up to 10 friends[/b] on [b]hosted servers[/b]! 🧑‍🤝‍🧑🌐[/p][p]Set up your own world, invite your crew, and explore, build, or survive [b]together[/b] like never before. No more limits—just endless fun with your squad.[/p][p][b]Grab your friends and jump in![/b]
Let us know what you build or discover together! 🛠️🌍🔥[/p]
